observations: Seller says they tested it and repeats claims, but provides no new photos or measurements.
Existing photos still show Maxxis sidewall text (photo 2) and good tread pattern, but do not show tire size, DOT date, or full 360° condition.

claims.claim: This is a girst grade Tokumbo tires that will last almost like new brand ones.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of 'Tokumbo' origin/grade; only tread and brand text are visible.
No tread-depth measurement (mm) or gauge reading shown in photos.
No clear patch area is visible in the provided angles; photos do not show full circumference/inner sidewall where repairs/bulges may be.
No DOT date code or vehicle documentation shown to confirm 2023.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: No test results or new photos/measurements were provided to verify the claims remotely.

risks.risk: Tire size/load/speed rating not readable; wrong size can make the tire unusable for the buyer.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the complete size marking and load/speed rating (e.g., 195/65R15 91H).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case fit risk (buyer should treat as not confirmed for their vehicle).

risks.risk: DOT date/age not shown; age affects safety even with good tread.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code (week/year) for each tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older/unknown age (worst-case reduced remaining life).

risks.risk: Hidden damage/repairs not fully verifiable from cropped angles (internal sidewall, bead area, full tread circumference).
risks.proof: 360° photos of each tire (both sidewalls and full tread) plus close-ups of any suspicious spots; ideally a photo of the inside bead area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially repaired/unknown condition (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Quantity consistency not explicitly confirmed (photos appear to show 2 tires, but not explicitly stated).
risks.proof: Confirm the exact number of tires included and whether both are the same size/model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming the worst-case quantity/consistency (buyer must confirm before paying).

proof_requests: Send clear sidewall close-ups showing the full tire size + load/speed rating for each tire.
Send close-up of DOT date code (week/year) for each tire.
Send 360° photos of each tire (both sidewalls and full tread, no cropping).
Confirm exact number of tires included and whether both are identical (size/model/tread pattern).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. From the current photos, the key pricing drivers (exact size and DOT age) are still not readable, and 'no patch/no bulge' and '90% tread' cannot be measured remotely from these angles.
